title: polyEval is additive over polyAdd, up to Complex.Equiv
statement: For any c, g, n, x: polyEval (polyAdd c g) n x is Complex.Equiv to polyEval c n x + polyEval g n x -- polyEval is an additive homomorphism from polyAdd to Complex addition, up to Complex's own (undecidable) setoid equality Equiv.

formal.statement: theorem Complex.polyEval_polyAdd : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : Complex) -> Complex.Equiv (Complex.polyEval (Complex.polyAdd x0 x1) x2 x3) (Complex.add (Complex.polyEval x0 x2 x3) (Complex.polyEval x1 x2 x3))))))
